Messages.Author: John
Messages.Body:
There does not appear to be any restriction against
tapping a minion with a starshell grenade launcher
more than once per action (other than the inherent problem
of untapping each time). So this leads me to....

I am being bled at 3 stealth, I have two minions, one of whom
has animalism and a starshell grenade launcher. Can I

Tap minion with SGL to give other minion +1 intercept
untap SGL minion with Rats warning, tap again to give second intercept
untap minion with Guard dogs and tap to give 3rd intercept

and if had superior animalism and auspex could do again with Read the winds so
long as the attempted block fails, leaving SGL minion untapped to then tap
to give intercept. (4th if 4 was needed)

Is it legal? What am I missing (aside from only works against a bleed)?

-JTP
